editorial_candidates.excerpt: The theorem identifies the free right-right Hopf module M^{coH}⊗H with M by α(n⊗h)=nh, with inverse β(m)=ΣP(m₀)⊗m₁, where P(m)=Σm₀S(m₁).
editorial_candidates.why_warranted: The central result is an explicit isomorphism and inverse between two Hopf modules. A compact two-way map diagram would make the objects, directions, and inverse relation easy to scan.
editorial_candidates.diagram_content: Show M^{coH}⊗H ⇄ M with α(n⊗h)=nh on the forward arrow and β(m)=ΣP(m₀)⊗m₁ on the reverse arrow. Annotate βα=id_{M^{coH}⊗H} and αβ=id_M, and identify P(m)=Σm₀S(m₁) as the projection into the coinvariant factor. Label the left object with the free right-right Hopf-module structure.
editorial_candidates.mathematical_check: All objects, maps, and inverse identities are asserted in the Statement (lines 36–44) and proved in lines 64–74. This is an explanatory diagram only; it adds no proof step or assumption about bijectivity of S.
